description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Transmission Shift Lever Upper Case Rebuild Kit for 1990 – 1995 Samurai’s.
Includes the 12mm Locating Bolts & Sheet
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Transmission Shift Lever Upper Case Rebuild Kit
Per the Diagram You Will Get the Following Part Numbers:
Qty – 1 Pin, Low Speed Select Guide
Qty – 1 Pin, Reverse Select Guide
Qty – 2 Spring, Select Return
Qty – 1 Ball
Qty – 1 Spring, Inner
Qty – 1 Spring, Outer
Qty – 1 Screw, Reverse Guide Pin
Qty – 2 Plug
Qty – 1 Bolt, Lever Locating 12mm
Qty – 1 Washer
Qty – 1 Shifter Sheet
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1990 – 1995 All Models
